summary: Ituran Location and Control Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to announce a $10 million cash dividend ($0.50 per share) approved by its Board of Directors for Q1 2026. The dividend, net of 20% withholding tax under Israeli tax law, will be paid on July 8, 2026 to shareholders of record as of June 24, 2026. The Board confirmed the distribution meets Israeli law criteria and will not impair operations; retained earnings post-distribution are $221.3 million, with $108 million cash on hand and no bank debt. This is a regular quarterly capital return, not a special situation.
